evidence: No cPanel host was available to the audit.

findings.title: Pillow image-parser dependency floor allowed audited vulnerable releases

remediation.description: Pillow>=13.0,<14.0 is declared in both package sources and the regression test pins that floor.

residual_risk.description: Without a resolver lockfile, future dependency advisories still require periodic audit and update work.

findings.title: A 1 GiB filesystem cannot admit the shipped 1 GiB maximum under the two-working-copy rule

evidence.before_command_output: AUDIT/results/cpanel-disk-incoherence-repro.log: 1,073,741,824 free bytes; 2,214,592,512 required bytes for one 1 GiB default input; DiskSpaceError
evidence.after_command_output: AUDIT/results/cpanel-preflight-capacity-after.log: level=FAIL; configured two slots require 4.12 GiB for a 1 GiB maximum input and a 64 MiB reserve per slot

remediation.description: cPanel preflight now aggregates the larger media/document ceiling, two working copies, the temporary reserve, and every configured download slot against actual temp-dir free space. A shortfall is a FAIL returned by normal preflight.

operator_effect.description: The generic 1 GiB defaults are retained; a cPanel deployment with insufficient actual disk capacity is blocked instead of being represented as viable.

residual_risk.description: Actual free space can shrink after preflight due to retained data or other processes; the existing per-download production guard remains the runtime fail-closed layer.

findings.commit: 12aa5ea fix: reject impossible cpanel download capacity

findings.title: Presentation temporary-capacity example was ambiguous about code defaults

evidence.code_excerpt: The unset presentation temp default is 2 * 1024**3; example values are now explicitly documented as conservative cPanel overrides.

remediation.description: The environment example and feature/deployment guidance distinguish unset defaults from the conservative cPanel override profile.

gates.result: Six scripted jobs completed in 8.5834s; the scripted overflow/failover counts were Speechmatics-to-Deepgram=2 and AvalAI-to-Gemini=2.
